note: Set A is slightly better because it correctly extracts the Defocus aberration values for Charges 4, 6, and 10 (0 mas stellar size), whereas Set B misbinds almost all Defocus values to incorrect charges (e.g., assigning 4.6 nm to Charge 4 or 8 instead of 6). However, Set A contains a hallucinated claim for 'Charge 7' which does not exist in the table. Both sets frequently confuse the 0 mas (left table) and 1 mas (right table) conditions, applying values from one side to the conditions of the other.
